summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google and Samsung just launched the AI features Apple couldn’t with Siri
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Medical Device Maker UFP Technologies Hit by Cyberattack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 66 articles published in the last 24 hours
